The campus budget risk calculation successfully passed all tests with a perfect reward score, validating the core weighted-risk logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.86 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While the logic is robust, future iterations should re-check edge case assumptions in the weighted matrix to maintain the 1.00 mean reward.
